title: pilosella piloselloides subsp. florentiniformis
intro: Pilosella piloselloides subsp. florentiniformis, commonly known as a plant species within the Asteraceae family, is a subspecies of the Pilosella piloselloides plant. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella piloselloides subsp. florentiniformis include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
